crop: First min(50,N) rows, 1-based displayed frames; originals unchanged
peak: First raw maximum aperture in retained segment; no smoothing
nrmse: Linear interpolation to 101 progress points. RMSE relative to mean of OTHER 29 trials, divided by a common reference range for each variable: mean of the 30 individual retained peak-to-peak ranges.
aggregation: Arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation ddof=1 across 30 trials; descriptive consistency, not prediction error
